entries.5d2bd61bb3a5e6f6: As its basic management policy, the company will uphold its company motto of "credit first," and through its focus on FA equipment centered on industrial robots, which have anticipated demand for labor saving and automation at industrial manufacturing sites, it will use its excellent proposal capabilities as an "FA planner" as a weapon and advance high value-added sales activities that differentiate it from other companies.
